messages:
Avery: Leaving an open follow-up thread for today's all-hands 1: ask quick questions on strategy, positioning, or roadmap clarifications and we'll respond.

Jordan: Quick ask  when pitching to mid-market, should SEs lead with latency SLAs or cost predictability?

Sam: Short: lead with latency/availability for product teams, cost predictability for finance/procurement. Always call out our rollout tooling as a way to reduce risk.

Lee: Are we changing public mission text at all? I heard talk of "inference economics" in GTM.

Riya: Mission remains developer-first. Marketing will add a buyer-focused section on economics, but top-line stays about performance + reliability.

Jordan: Competitors  any shift in messaging vs cloud providers who are dropping GPU prices?

Sam: Emphasize operational guarantees (SLA, tracing, per-route observability), private deployment controls (KMS/HSM), and predictable unit economics via batching/caching recommendations. Price is one axis, not the whole story.

Avery: Roadmap brief: tracing internal alpha end-of-Q2, public beta Q3; per-route token/cost dashboards targeted Q3.

Lee: For demos before tracing beta, any quick script?

Riya: Demo tip: show per-request logs + simulate fallback using this sample config: {"route":"demo-chat","fallback":["rwd-small","rwd-micro"],"latency_slo_ms":150} and highlight autoscale behavior.

deploy-bot: Uploaded all-hands slides to #docs at 1799990055 :white_check_mark:

Avery: Thanks everyone 1 keep questions short here or DM if sensitive. We'll leave this thread open for 24h. :sparkles:
